## DotOS v0.2.0

First tagged release of the DotOS daily-wear layer since v0.1.3. Everything here
was flashed and validated on a real LILYGO T-Watch Ultra.

### Highlights
- **Hiking / GPX** — live GPX track recording (REC toggle), on-watch route
  follow, a PC map-tile tool, and BLE "share route to watch" (send a Gaia GPS
  route straight to `/gpx` from the phone).
- **Apps** — Bubble Level (bullseye + horizontal & vertical vials), a local
  MP3/FLAC Music player, a relative Compass, and a Human Detector.
- **Dot watchface** — reworked battery / notification / date layout, top-aligned
  status icons, two customizable data tiles, and a consolidated unread badge.
- **Notifications** — phone-notification relay via the companion app,
  unrenderable-glyph ("tofu") fix, and a tap-the-badge-to-open fix.
- **Reliability & power** — HexHound freeze fix, Notify-on-at-boot, a refined
  swipe-up wake with milder haptics, an AXP2101 charge policy, and the 4 MB
  partition layout.

### Flashing
Open **`DotOS-v0.2.0-flasher.html`** below in Chrome or Edge, plug the watch in
over USB-C, and click **Flash**. It writes all four images at their correct
offsets (bootloader `0x0`, partitions `0x8000`, boot_app0 `0xe000`, firmware
`0x10000`). To keep your settings (Notify, watchface, power) across the update,
flash **without** erasing the NVS partition.

> Pair with the matching **ARGD-OS Dashboard** app release for phone health,
> notification relay, and Gaia route push.
